main_text.head: PIO CANDIDOQUE LECTORI Jo. Henr. Heideggerus
Gratiam & Pacem à Domino Jesu Christo, Ecclesiæ Christianæ Salvatore & Capite unico, ardenter precatur.
main_text.p: MErito equidem ille admirabilis patientiæ athleta S. Jobus questus est cap. vii. i. הלא צבא לאנוש Annon militia est vita hominis ? Militiam certè continuam Supremus Imperator tum singulis fidelibus, tum universæ Ecclesiæ, quam & multi, & sæ-vi in mundo hostes circumsistunt, indixit; in qua, uti piè & scitè Tertullianus loquitur, Agonotheta est Deus Pater, Epistates Jesus Christus, Xystarches Spiritus Sanctus. Et ut de singulorum fidelium agonibus nihil dicam, in propatulo, si unquam alias, hodie sanè sunt certamina & παιγαλιεια Ecclesiæ Evangelicæ, quæ in mundo sustinet ab iis, qui soli Ecclesiæ
The initial letter M is a woodcut initial; the Hebrew phrase הלא צבא לאנוש is Job 7:1 and the Greek word παιγαλιεια is printed as it stands.

page.notes: The woodcut initial M is joined to "Erito" in the first line. Greek word "παιγαλιεια" is uncertain (printed as shown, possibly a misprint for παλαιστρα-type word) and is marked for checking. Show-through text from the reverse page (the faint "PRAEFATIO" heading and other lines) is not transcribed. The opening "M" is the initial, joined to the first word.
